# Code review

Fixed range: `78cd4e9807aa8a6ebf5a0d852b096b62180fb2da...7e67b3b29ea81a331cbbf5c139cd894d4acbb169` (merge-base equals the base; HEAD was the exact target). Authority: `.ak/dockets/issues/16/review/review-001/inputs/issue-16`. Latest accepted finding: `.ak/dockets/issues/16/review/review-012/receipt.json`.

## Standards

**Hard documented-standard violations:** None. No Soul files were changed, and regression behavior is contained in the owning Recorder test suite; no scratch/adjudication probe was committed, consistent with `CLAUDE.md` “Soul 内容分层” and “Probe lifecycle.”

### Judgement-call findings

1. **Mysterious Name — `src/recorder/extract.ts:314-343`**  
   `hasMismatchedCrossRepCallIdentity` does more than detect identity mismatches: it also rejects odd candidate counts and non-alternating representation order. The name hides its broader sequence-validation responsibility. Rename it to describe complete dual-terminal sequence validation or split those checks.

2. **Duplicated Code — `src/recorder/extract.ts:380-407`**  
   The same map-accumulation shape appears three times: `get(key) → push(value) else set(key, [value])` for terminals, issuances, and starts. A shared append-to-map helper would remove this repeated logic. This is a baseline judgement call, not a tooling or generated-dist issue.

`dist/recorder/extract.js` was treated as generated parity and not independently flagged.

Verification: exact clean target reviewed; `git diff --check` and `node --check dist/recorder/extract.js` passed. `npm run typecheck` and focused Recorder tests could not run in the isolated clone because dependencies were absent (`tsc`/`tsx` not found).

## Spec

No findings. All listed issue #16 obligations appear closed at `7e67b3b`:

- Complete one-to-one pairing and positional extra-terminal rejection: `src/recorder/extract.ts:314-343`; all four leading/trailing forms at `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts:1604-1658`.
- Independent failed-call/successful-retry acceptance: `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts:1584-1602`.
- Complete content/details equality: `src/recorder/extract.ts:281-305`, including non-text conflicts at `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts:1490-1507`.
- Shared issuance/start law: `invocationMatches` at `src/recorder/extract.ts:352-358`, used by canonicalization (`:432-439`) and binding (`:552-562`).
- Tee-only usage copied without mutation: `src/recorder/extract.ts:442-453`; Judge/Reviewer regressions at `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts:1398-1467`.
- Typed Receipt/audit promotion and production-shaped Recorder coverage: `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts:1340-1396,1964+`.
- Per-envelope canonicalization with cross-channel mismatch detection: `src/recorder/extract.ts:691-723`.
- No product scope changes beyond source, generated dist, and Recorder regressions; Souls/orchestration/migration remain untouched. Source and checked-in dist logic match.

A temporary no-file probe confirmed sequential failed-call/successful-retry returns only the retry Receipt; no scratch artifacts remain. Full/focused tests and typecheck could not run in the isolated clone because dependencies were absent.

Summary: Standards — 2 judgement-call findings, worst: the sequence validator’s misleading name; Spec — 0 findings, worst: none.
